name: Touched while irritated, Boop answers crossly, and a stroke softens it a step
case: Boop is irritated while an agent session is open. The person pokes it once: a cross face, irritated, annoyed or grumpy, never a grin or a giggle, and it stays irritated or turns grumpy. A minute later they stroke it: it softens a step to annoyed, with an annoyed or calm face, not a cheerful one.
why: The owner's note of 2026-10-26, after doing this live: poked or swiped while irritated, Boop answered with a comfy face and a giggle; the reaction to a touch should follow the mood. The guide: a touch never cheers a sad or cross MOOD's face. character/steering/mood/irritated.md: its faces lean irritated at a poke too; a stroke moves it to annoyed
